title: LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.16368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared Transformer modules, yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, largely designed for feed-forward Transformers, fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics, heterogeneous loop sensitivity, and recursive error propagation, leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. To address these challenges, we propose LoopQuant, a loop-aware PTQ framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of LoopLMs. LoopQuant is built on three core components: 1) Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization (CLDC) learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing; 2) Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation (ILPA) allocates activation precision under a fix

translated_title: LoopQuant：面向循环Transformer的精准高效训练后量化
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型通过递归复用共享的Transformer模块来提升参数效率，但其在不断演化的循环状态上进行重复计算，为低比特部署带来了新的挑战。现有的训练后量化（PTQ）方法大多为前馈Transformer设计，未能考虑跨循环激活动态、异构的循环敏感性以及递归误差传播，导致在低精度下性能显著下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出LoopQuant，一个循环感知的训练后量化框架，用于对循环语言模型进行精准高效的低比特量化。LoopQuant建立在三个核心组件之上：1）跨循环分布规范化（CLDC），在学习跨循环状态共享的量化友好表示的同时保持参数共享；2）交互感知的循环级精度分配（ILPA），在固定……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: LoopQuant提出了一个循环感知的训练后量化框架，通过跨循环分布规范化和交互感知的循环级精度分配等核心组件，解决了循环语言模型在低比特量化中跨循环激活动态与递归误差传播的难题，实现精准高效的低比特部署。
en_tdlr: LoopQuant is a loop-aware post-training quantization framework that tackles cross-loop activation dynamics and recursive error propagation in Looped Language Models, achieving accurate and efficient low-bit deployment through components such as Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization and Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation.
